title: Pair-Merge Tokenisation Is Hard to Approximate on Binary Strings and Strongly NP-Hard on Unary Datasets
abstract: arXiv:2611.13568v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Tokenisers such as Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) shorten text by repeatedly merging an adjacent pair of symbols into a new one; fewer tokens mean less computation. We ask whether an efficient algorithm can choose $k$ merges that leave a string of length $n$ almost as short as possible; doing nothing is already within a factor $n$. We prove that, unless P = NP, no polynomial-time algorithm comes within a factor $c\,n/\log n$, for some constant $c>0$, already for one binary string and for BPE-style merges that replace every occurrence. The key idea is that $k$ merges form a grammar with $k$ rules: a vertex-cover gap becomes a grammar-size gap, which we amplify with relabelled copies, encode in binary and realise with explicit merges. For merges that may skip occurrences, a simple algorithm achieves $O(n/\log\log n)$, and no Karp reduction can prove hardness beyond order $n/\log n$ unless coNP $\subseteq$ NP/poly. translated_title: 成对合并分词在二进制字符串上难以近似，且在一元数据集上是强NP难的
translated_abstract: 诸如字节对编码（BPE）之类的分词器通过反复将相邻的一对符号合并成新符号来缩短文本；更少的标记意味着更少的计算量。我们提出这样一个问题：是否存在一种高效算法，能够选择 k 次合并，使得长度为 n 的字符串尽可能接近最短；即使什么都不做，结果也已经在因子 n 之内。我们证明，除非 P = NP，对于某个常数 c > 0，任何多项式时间算法都无法在因子 c·n/log n 之内近似该问题——即便输入只是单个二进制字符串，且合并是替换所有出现位置的BPE式合并。其核心思想是：k 次合并构成一个带 k 条规则的文法，于是顶点覆盖的间隙可以转化为文法大小的间隙，我们通过重新标记的副本将其放大，用二进制编码，并通过显式的合并操作加以实现。对于允许跳过某些出现位置的合并方式，一个简单算法可以达到 O(n/log log n) 的近似，并且除非 coNP ⊆ NP/poly，否则任何 Karp 归约都无法证明超出 n/log n 量级的难度。在单字母（一元）字母表上……（摘要内容截断于此）
tldr: 本文通过将顶点覆盖间隙转化为文法大小间隙的归约技术，证明了BPE式成对合并分词优化问题即使仅在单个二进制字符串上也难以近似（除非P=NP，近似因子不超过c·n/log n），且在一元字母表数据集上是强NP难的。
en_tdlr: This paper proves via a vertex-cover-to-grammar-size gap reduction that optimizing BPE-style pair-merge tokenisation is hard to approximate—unless P=NP, no polynomial-time algorithm achieves a c·n/log n approximation factor even on a single binary string—and the problem is strongly NP-hard on unary datasets.
